acceptedAnswer.text: A real estate agent specializing in foreign buyers, such as Kelby Contreras, can connect you with lenders who offer foreign national mortgage products. Our role is to guide you through the property search in areas like Aventura or Sunny Isles Beach, coordinate with lenders, and facilitate a smooth transaction, helping you navigate the local market nuances.
